children.value: > Fact From Story: Alameda was allowed to withdraw and transfer those funds and had a $65 billion line of credit.
> > Fact From Story: When customers deposited USD, it went to Alameda.
> > > Fact From Story: Alameda owing FTX $8 billion worth of customer deposits.
> > > Fact From Story: Alameda could have negative balances and unlimited withdrawals.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Unlimited withdrawals allow a person to withdraw any amount of money from an account.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A line of credit allows a person to borrow money, and they are expected to pay it back.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Giving someone a large line of credit allows them to withdraw funds.
